title: The k-th Lexicographical String of All Happy Strings of Length n
goal: Return the kth lexicographic length-n string over a,b,c with no equal neighbors.
strategy: Depth-first generation tries letters in sorted order and skips the previous letter. Complete leaves therefore arrive in lexicographic order.
